description: This file defines an abstract class 'SiloHandle' representing a handle to a remotely deployed silo in Orleans testing infrastructure. It includes properties for configuration, address, name, and lifecycle management, as well as abstract methods for stopping silos and disposing resources.

classes.name: SiloHandle
classes.description: Abstract class representing a handle to manage a remote Orleans silo in testing scenarios, providing properties and methods for lifecycle management and resource cleanup.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Performs cleanup by invoking Dispose(true) and suppressing finalization.

methods.name: Dispose(bool disposing)
methods.description: Virtual method that stops the silo asynchronously if it is active; meant to be overridden for custom cleanup.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync(bool stopGracefully)
methods.description: Abstract method to stop the silo gracefully or abruptly.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync(CancellationToken ct)
methods.description: Abstract method to stop the silo with cancellation support.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Abstract method for asynchronous disposal pattern.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the silo address.
